steps.title: Подзапросы и CTE
steps.content:
## Подзапросы

`IN`, `NOT IN`, `EXISTS`, скалярные подзапросы. **`WITH`** (CTE) для читаемости. Осторожно с `NOT IN` и NULL.

steps.title: 1978. Employees Whose Manager Left the Company

content.description:
Сотрудники с `salary` **строго меньше 30000**, чей менеджер (`manager_id`) **больше не работает** в компании. Колонка `employee_id`, сортировка по возрастанию.

[LeetCode 1978](https://leetcode.com/problems/employees-whose-manager-left-the-company/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, manager_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT employee_id FROM Employees WHERE salary < 30000 AND manager_id IS NOT NULL AND manager_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Employees) ORDER BY employee_id;

content.description:
Поменяйте местами соседей: нечётный `id` меняется с `id+1`, последний нечётный остаётся. Колонка `id` (новый порядок), `student`.

[LeetCode 626](https://leetcode.com/problems/exchange-seats/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Seat(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CASE WHEN id % 2 = 1 AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM Seat) THEN id WHEN id % 2 = 1 THEN id + 1 ELSE id - 1 END AS id, student FROM Seat ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Две строки, одна колонка `results`: (1) имя пользователя с **наибольшим** числом оценок (при ничьей — по алфавиту); (2) название фильма с **наибольшим средним** рейтингом в **феврале 2020** (при ничьей — по алфавиту).

[LeetCode 1341](https://leetcode.com/problems/movie-rating/)
content.starterCode: SELECT name AS results FROM Users ORDER BY name LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT results FROM (SELECT u.name AS results FROM Users u JOIN MovieRating mr ON u.user_id = mr.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.name LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT results FROM (SELECT m.title AS results FROM Movies m JOIN MovieRating mr ON m.movie_id = mr.movie_id WHERE strftime("%Y-%m", mr.created_at) = "2020-02" GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title ORDER BY AVG(mr.rating) DESC, m.title LIMIT 1);

content.description:
Скользящая сумма `amount` за **7** дней по `visited_on` (окно из 7 последовательных дней с данными). Колонки `visited_on`, `amount`, `average_amount` (округлить 2). Только даты, от которых есть 7 дней истории.

[LeetCode 1321](https://leetcode.com/problems/restaurant-growth/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Customer(customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, visited_on TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH daily AS (SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on)
SELECT d1.visited_on, SUM(d2.amount) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(d2.amount) * 1.0 / 7, 2) AS average_amount FROM daily d1 JOIN daily d2 ON julianday(d2.visited_on) BETWEEN julianday(d1.visited_on) - 6 AND julianday(d1.visited_on) GROUP BY d1.visited_on HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d2.visited_on) = 7 ORDER BY d1.visited_on;

steps.title: 602. Friend Requests II: Who Has the Most Friends

content.description:
Пользователь с **наибольшим** числом друзей (связь в `RequestAccepted` **неориентированная**). Колонка `friend` (id), `friend_count`.

[LeetCode 602](https://leetcode.com/problems/friend-requests-ii-who-has-the-most-friends/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE RequestAccepted(requester_id INTEGER NOT NULL, accepter_id INTEGER NOT NULL, accept_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT requester_id AS friend, COUNT(*) FROM RequestAccepted GROUP BY requester_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT id AS friend, COUNT(*) AS friend_count FROM (SELECT requester_id AS id FROM RequestAccepted UNION ALL SELECT accepter_id FROM RequestAccepted) GROUP BY id ORDER BY friend_count DESC LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Сумма `tiv_2016` полисов, у которых `tiv_2015` **совпадает хотя бы у двух** разных полисов, а пара `(lat, lon)` **уникальна** в таблице (встречается ровно один раз). Колонка `tiv_2016` (округлить 2).

[LeetCode 585](https://leetcode.com/problems/investments-in-2016/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Insurance(pid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tiv_2015 REAL NOT NULL, tiv_2016 REAL NOT NULL, lat REAL NOT NULL, lon REAL NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(SUM(tiv_2016), 2) AS tiv_2016 FROM Insurance WHERE (lat, lon) IN (SELECT lat, lon FROM Insurance GROUP BY lat, lon HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AND tiv_2015 IN (SELECT tiv_2015 FROM Insurance GROUP BY tiv_2015 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

content.description:
Сотрудники, входящие в **топ-3** оклада **в своём** отделе. Колонки: `Department`, `Employee`, `Salary`.

[LeetCode 185](https://leetcode.com/problems/department-top-three-salaries/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL, departmentId INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Department(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, e.salary AS Salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, e.salary AS Salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.salary) FROM Employee e2 WHERE e2.departmentId = e.departmentId AND e2.salary >= e.salary) <= 3 ORDER BY Department, Salary DESC;
